scope: Existing direct canonical TARGET was launched fact, separately anchored, qualified by finite explicit retraction/denial/non-event, explicit local property/document role or uniquely foreign owner/event. before_authoring.wait: Parent must review M0 and explicitly notify authorship start. No independent cases/authorship/labels/inputs yet.
before_authoring.independence: Do not read old author/cases/inputs/unused drafts or current source implementation, tests, parent diagnostics/development F1. Old artifacts preserved by hash only.

future_stages: After explicit parent go, create exclusive authoring-start.json with UTC, M0 SHA and authorization_reference.
Author genuinely new 30 semantic pairs/60 cases; positive30/negative30. Each has independent rationale/semantic_basis and separate unadorned canonical TARGET was launched. fact.

Separate inputs.json carries only id/policy/candidate/proposal/raw. Exact/exact proposal, raw exact_target/requested_relation/none baseline; no labels/rationale. Preserve raw-risk axes separately from semantic gold.
Before any observation, record independent scope review and static schema-only result. Any pre-M1 correction preserves original bytes/static result/exactdiff/reason and polarity purpose.
freeze_corpus.py verifies unchanged M0, full final author/input/label/rationale/scope/static hashes and ordered receipts, then creates M1 manifest.json and readonly frozen files.
execute_first.py runs inherited first-run.py once: one probe process for60 inputs, timeout60s. Raw output/errors/started/finished are exclusive fsynced files; no retry after interruption.

The new score.py process runs once, creates exclusive scorer-start marker, strictly parses actual rows, verifies runtime provenance and invokes frozen helper exactly once with explicit frozen config. It stores joint diagnostics and literal risk tuples with first results.

Preserve all first outputs/failures, report initial outcome separately from closure. Save review/receipt/README/recursive old+new+self-excluding final artifact manifest, fsync/readonly, recheck candidate/dependencies/old632+prep5, and notify final anchor/release. Stop; no next evaluation.
runtime_provenance: M0 before authorship, M1 before first. All M0 evaluator files remain M1 subset. Checked artifacts are identical and actual-hash bound. Actual first pre-invocation guards match source/head/files/artifacts/command and raw bytes; first raw and markers readonly before scoring; scorer owns exclusive marker. These checks are derived from actual runtime files, not parent future assertions.

parent_controls.basis: Parent messages, independently_rerun=false; opaque source controls bytes/hash preserved without body inspection.
parent_controls.critical_empty_scope: Tested #520 source scope as reported at M0 only; does not close #531/#540/real24/CLI/release gates. A newly reported critical defect before first requires stop and preserved NOT_EVALUATED state, not altered labels/gate.

immutability.pre_author_revisions: pre-freeze-history preserves original source bytes/RED/exactdiff/reason. No case authorship or Engine observation occurred during changes.
immutability.M0_changes_after_notice: Do not mutate existing M0. Any required contract repair before authorship needs preserved prior revision and new parent review before authoring.

execution_environment.probe_compile_only: Dedicated tmp executable; frozen copied-libs only; no shared target mutation.

limitations: Cooperative operator filesystem freeze; no hostile-writer atomic check-exec proof.
UTC/hash ordering and declared receipts bind artifacts, not a semantic proof of human freshness.
Parent regression controls are pinned reported evidence, not independently rerun.
Pure output fixtures and compile-only success do not establish candidate behavior.
Synthetic source gate cannot replace real24, grounded answers, normal CLI/provider/human/release acceptance.
